claim.statement: A blocked trade lacks observed execution outcome, so gate evaluation must record the missing counterfactual outcome instead of pretending ordinary supervised labels are complete.
claim.evidence_summary: Counterfactual risk minimization literature frames logged feedback as biased/censored, which maps to blocked-trade outcome gaps in gate evaluation.
claim.interpretation_notes: This candidate is scoped to AI Engineering governance for LLM trade quality scoring/gating systems. It does not define trading signals, order execution rules, or strategy parameters.

applies_when: Building or auditing LLM training, RAG, MCP, evaluation, or governance for trade quality scoring/gating assistants.
not_applicable_when: The task asks for concrete trading entries, exits, position sizing, account-specific settings, or live order execution.
assumptions: External projects provide project facts and private data; CEK-TA stores only generalized reusable knowledge.
limitations: Candidate requires human or AI audit before conversion to formal reviewed knowledge.

content_patch_notes: 正式 statement 建议保留核心含义：blocked trade lacks observed execution outcome; gate evaluation must record counterfactual_missing rather than treating ordinary supervised labels as complete.
增加 action：counterfactual_missing 样本不得进入普通 supervised outcome label 训练池，除非有 approved OPE / simulation / human review evidence。
